name: Skeleton
blurb: Placeholder blocks that hold the shape of content while it loads.
mechanism: One class, one keyframe. The shimmer is a moving background-position on a gradient, so there is no extra element and nothing to clean up when the real content arrives.
caveats: A skeleton is decoration: mark the region aria-busy="true" and hide the blocks with aria-hidden, or a screen reader reads a wall of nothing.
Shimmer is motion. The keyframe stops under prefers-reduced-motion and falls back to a flat block.
